style.styleTitle: Premier Decorations Ltd 1.8m Lit Snowy Cedar Christmas Garland with 120 LED Lights
style.toneOfVoice: Add a warm and elegant glow to your Christmas decorations with this 1.8 m lit snowy cedar garland. The stylish design is enhanced by 120 warm white LEDs, providing a steady glow to create a beautiful illuminated display. Complete with a 5 m lead cable and a convenient timer function with 8 hours on followed by 16 hours off, it is easy to enjoy your display each day. Suitable for indoor use, this illuminated garland creates a stylish finishing touch for Christmas displays.
